_doc: Forms for the Projects page. One entry per workflow. The fields, in order, become the workflow's input line after the client slug. Keep the number of fields equal to the parts of the line 'Đầu vào gồm' in the workflow (python tools/seo_ops.py check verifies it).

forms.title: Summarise new data
forms.what: After uploading GSC, rank or GA4 files: writes the period summary and the latest summary that every other task reads.

fields.label: Period
fields.help: YYYY-MM-DD (week end), YYYY-MM (month), or mới nhất for the newest file.

forms.after: Nothing. If the summary lists files older than 13 weeks, move them to an _archive folder yourself.

forms.title: 1. Seed keywords
forms.what: Suggests 3-5 seed keywords per collection and product page from page data.

fields.label: Run topic
fields.help: Short name for this planning round: lowercase, hyphens.

forms.after: Take seed_for_ahrefs.txt to Ahrefs Keywords Explorer (client's country, Matching terms), export, and upload it in Data > Ahrefs keyword export. Then run 2. Filter and level.

forms.title: 2. Filter and level keywords
forms.what: Drops local and branded terms, sets easy / medium / difficult against the site's DR, and writes the file for the grouping sheet.

fields.label: Ahrefs export
fields.help: mới nhất, or a file name in data/keywords/.

forms.after: Put for_grouping_<country>.csv through the team's grouping sheet, export the result and add it to the run as groups_<country>.csv (Runs > Add file). Then run 3. Mapping and cluster.

forms.title: 3. Keyword mapping and cluster
forms.what: Maps one main keyword to each URL, flags duplicates, then groups by topic and sub-topic.

fields.label: Grouped keywords file
fields.help: File name inside the run folder.

forms.after: Review keyword_mapping and content_cluster, edit them if needed, then run 4. Priority plan.

forms.title: 4. Draft priority plan
forms.what: Drafts priority and timeline per product group from the mapping and cluster. A person decides.
forms.after: Decide the plan. When agreed: Runs > Approve, and pick keyword_mapping, content_cluster and priority_plan.

forms.title: Brief (optional)
forms.what: Optional brief for one page, checked by the reviewer. Not required before writing.
forms.after: Approve the brief, then run Start blog or collection and pick this run.

forms.title: Start blog or collection
forms.what: Blog: real SERP research and 3-5 title options. Collection: strategy report and outline. Stops for your decision.

fields.label: Run
fields.help: Pick the brief's run, or start a new one.

fields.label: Notes
fields.help: Intent, top-sellers file name, or không.

forms.after: Blog: pick a title, then run Blog outline. Collection: approve the outline, then run Write the draft.

forms.title: Blog outline
forms.what: Builds the outline from the title you chose. Stops for approval.

fields.label: Chosen title
fields.help: Its number in titles.md, or the full title.

forms.after: Approve or edit outline.md, then run Write the draft.

forms.title: Write the draft
forms.what: Writes the full piece from the approved outline, with the meta package.
forms.after: Run QA and fix on draft.md.

forms.title: QA and fix
forms.what: Checks references first, then E-E-A-T, compliance and the skill's rules; fixes P0 and P1 into a _v2 file; re-checks.
forms.after: Check the source links by hand, then Runs > Approve. If it is not good enough, run QA again on the _v2 file.

forms.title: Blog image plan
forms.what: Table of images for a finished blog: position, file name, alt text, prompt.
forms.after: Create the images outside Javis and place them in the post.

forms.title: Apply feedback or localise
forms.what: Edits a piece from client feedback or adapts it to another market, then re-checks.

fields.label: Feedback
fields.help: Write feedback: <text>, or a feedback file name in the run.

forms.after: Approve the new version in Runs.

forms.title: 1. Product analysis and keywords
forms.what: Reads the Shopify export, analyses each product and builds its keyword set.

fields.label: Product URLs or handles
fields.help: Comma separated. Up to about 10 per batch.

fields.label: Run topic
fields.help: Short name for the batch: lowercase, hyphens.

forms.after: Take keywords_for_ahrefs.txt to Ahrefs, export search volume, and add it to the run as ahrefs_volume.csv (Runs > Add file). Then run 2. Meta and content.

forms.title: 2. Meta and content
forms.what: Picks the main keyword by the volume rule, then writes meta and product content.
forms.after: Run QA and fix on meta_table.csv.

forms.title: Technical audit
forms.what: Audits the view-source HTML samples per template and writes a fix list for the developer.

fields.label: Run topic
fields.help: For example the sample date, or sau-fix-1.

fields.label: Scope
fields.help: tất cả, or a note such as chỉ product.

forms.after: Approve the report and send it to the developer. After the fix, upload fresh HTML samples and run it again.

forms.title: On-page audit
forms.what: Audits a list of live URLs with their GSC and rank data.

fields.label: URLs
fields.help: Comma separated, or a file name.

forms.after: Choose which findings to fix.

forms.title: Find pages losing clicks
forms.what: Compares the last 4 weeks with the 4 before, opens each page and its real SERP, and recommends refresh or leave.
forms.after: Pick the pages to refresh, then run Refresh one page for each.

forms.title: Refresh one page
forms.what: Updates one page you chose, keeping what works.

fields.label: Direction
fields.help: What to change and what to keep.

forms.after: Run QA and fix on the refresh file.

forms.title: Post-publish check
forms.what: Checks the live URL against the approved file: meta, canonical, indexability, links, structured data, content.
forms.after: Fix what the report lists.

forms.title: Competing pages and internal links
forms.what: Finds pages competing for the same main keyword and missing internal links, and proposes fixes.
forms.after: Choose the fixes.

forms.title: Backlink profile, gaps, outreach drafts
forms.what: Summarises the backlink profile, lists link gaps against the competitors, proposes targets and PR angles, drafts outreach.
forms.after: Approve targets and drafts, find contacts and send everything yourself. Nothing is sent automatically.

forms.title: GEO optimisation
forms.what: From the tracked AI prompts and citation checks: audits pages and drafts answer-first fixes.
forms.after: Approve the proposal, then run QA and fix on it.

forms.title: Monthly report
forms.what: Builds the month's report from GSC, GA4, rank and citations; the reviewer checks every number.
forms.after: Approve the report before it goes to the client.
